gloss: plagiarism; unauthorized use; theft (of ideas, designs, or writings)

definitions.gloss: plagiarism; unauthorized use; theft (of ideas, designs, writings, identity)
definitions.explanation: The act of using someone else's work, ideas, design, or property without permission and presenting them as one's own. Applies to written work, designs, identities, and other intellectual property.

notes:
Composed of {盗|とう} (steal) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use). Refers to using something — typically intellectual or informational — without authorization and passing it off as one's own or as legitimately acquired. Commonly applied to academic plagiarism, design/copyright infringement, and identity/information theft.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗用|とうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to plagiarize; to use without authorization
- {盗用|とうよう}⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧: suspicion of plagiarism
- {盗用|とうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧: plagiarism is uncovered
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧{盗用|とうよう}: plagiarism of a paper
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧{盗用|とうよう}: identity theft
- {盗用|とうよう}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage from unauthorized use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{剽窃|ひょうせつ}→剽窃：23253_hyousetsu⟧: plagiarism — more literary/specialized; typically used of written work
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: improper use; unauthorized use — broader; often used for unauthorized use of accounts or tools
- ⟦{模倣|もほう}→模倣：15752_mohou⟧: imitation — not necessarily wrongful; describes copying without implying theft
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: unauthorized use — emphasizes lack of permission; overlaps with {盗用|とうよう} but is neutral in tone

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{東洋|とうよう}→東洋：03454_touyou⟧: the East; the Orient — different word, same reading
- ⟦{登用|とうよう}→登用：17153_touyou⟧: appointment, promotion (to a position) — different word, same reading

USAGE:
Frequently appears in academic misconduct cases, corporate design disputes, and news stories about cybercrime. Often pairs with verbs like ⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧ (to come to light) and ⟦{疑|うたが}われる→疑う：01889_utagau⟧ (to be suspected).
